name: Uber One

fastest.text: In the app you joined with (Uber or Uber Eats), open Uber One, select Manage Membership, then End membership.

steps: Open the app you joined Uber One with: Uber or Uber Eats.
Open the Uber One section of your account.
Select Manage Membership, then End membership.
Confirm. Paid members keep their benefits until the end of the billing cycle.
note: You cancel in the app; Uber's terms don't offer a way to end Uber One on the website.

faq.a: Not for the current billing cycle, and there are no pro-rata refunds. But if you cancel in the 24 hours before renewal and that payment has already gone through, Uber refunds it automatically.
Paid members keep them until the end of the current billing cycle. On a free trial they end as soon as you cancel.

faq.q: What happens to my Uber One credits?
faq.a: Credits you earned before cancelling can't be used without an active membership.
